id: W:knibiehler|histoire des meres et de la maternite en occident
original_title: Histoire des mères et de la maternité en Occident
note: Catalogue explicitly names Yvonne Knibiehler and confirms the 2000 first edition and ISBN. The citation’s 2017 fourth edition is the same work, distinct from the supplied 1980 book; its ebook ISBN is 9782130800422.

French title names Diodorus’s ancient work. LCCN grounds the collected Greek text, catalogued as Diodori bibliotheca historica (Teubner, 1888–1906). Original composition year unknown; the particular French 1978 volume remains unspecified.

French title names Cassius Dio’s ancient Roman History. LCCN identifies the collected Greek text edited by Boissevain, catalogued as Cassii Dionis Cocceiani Historiarum romanarum quae supersunt (1895–1931). Original year unknown; no particular French 2002 volume inferred.

note: The LCCN requires its alphabetic prefix: a43002349, not 43002349. Harvard and HathiTrust 000025824 confirm Trachtenberg’s 1943 Yale edition; 1983 is a later JPS edition.
